title: Veeri Singh v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Amreshwar Pratap Sahi, J.; Rajiv Lochan Mehrotra, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to departmental remedies
headnote: On counsel's request after the matter was heard, the Division Bench dismissed the writ as withdrawn, with liberty to the petitioner to pursue any departmental remedy available under the Electricity Act, 2003 read with the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Court did not examine the merits of the supply dispute.
facts: Veeri Singh filed Writ-C No. 41420 of 2017 in the Allahabad High Court against the State of Uttar Pradesh and two others. The Division Bench of Amreshwar Pratap Sahi and Rajiv Lochan Mehrotra, JJ. heard the matter. The order does not set out the facts of the underlying electricity grievance. After hearing, counsel for the petitioner, Sri Madan Mohan, sought leave to withdraw the writ so that the petitioner could pursue any other departmental remedy available under the Electricity Act, 2003 read with the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.holding: The writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to the petitioner to avail any other departmental remedy available under the Electricity Act, 2003 read with the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
holding_units.flag: Order styles the statute as 'U.P.Electricity Act, 2003' (Electricity Act, 2003); no section or Supply Code clause is identified.

not_decided.point: Merits of the petitioner's electricity grievance
not_decided.note: Writ withdrawn without adjudication; liberty reserved to departmental remedies under the Electricity Act, 2003 and the Supply Code, 2005.
